lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in at least four identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular blob clusters to form high-contrast anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots that differ in size and spacing from the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
